Title: Why Tartar Builds Up Fast (And How to Stop It)

Description:
Most people think brushing alone keeps tartar away. It doesn't - plaque can harden into tartar in as little as 24 hours once calcium and phosphate in your saliva get to it. Three everyday gaps speed that up: missing the spaces between teeth, skipping the night brush, and grazing on sugar all day. Close those gaps and tartar never gets a foothold.
